name: American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Credit Card

mpd:flight_booking.note: On eligible Singapore Airlines and Scoot flight bookings, KrisShop and Pelago purchases, with no cap.

highlights: Earn 2 miles per dollar on eligible flight bookings with Singapore Airlines and Scoot. You can also earn up to 2 miles per dollar on eligible transport transactions with Grab Singapore, capped at S$200 spend each calendar month. For all other local and overseas spending, enjoy 1.1 milesper dollar.

pros: Receive S$150 Cashback for use on your next eligible purchase on singaporeair.com or the SingaporeAir mobile app with a minimum spend of S$800 in a single transaction, when you spend S$12,000 or more on eligible purchases with your Card within the qualifying period.
pros: Earn 2 KrisFlyer miles for every S$1 spent on eligible Singapore Airlines and Scoot flight bookings, KrisShop and Pelago purchases, with no cap.
pros: Earn 1.1 KrisFlyer miles for every S$1 spent on all other eligible purchases, with no cap.
pros: Enjoy hassle-free conversion as all KrisFlyer miles earned with the American Express Singapore Airlines KrisFlyer Credit Card are conveniently credited directly into your KrisFlyer account.
